image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a cooked Dungeness crab resting on a white plate. The crab's carapace is a vibrant orange-red, typical of cooked crustaceans. The ventral side (underside) is visible, showing the folded abdomen and the base of the legs. Several legs are splayed out, with one prominent claw visible in the foreground. In the background, there is another partial crab shell and a glass container, suggesting a dining setting.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The large claw/leg in the foreground appears to merge somewhat unnaturally with the body plate. The joint structure lacks clear definition, looking slightly 'melted' or fused rather than mechanically articulated.
The secondary crab shell in the upper right has a very smooth, plastic-like texture that lacks the fine surface imperfections seen on the main subject, suggesting inconsistent rendering detail.
The rim of the plate and the glass in the background show slight warping and inconsistent perspective lines, common in AI-generated dining scenes.
